title: Jay B shares a new single "I Been"
htmlContent:
Jay B has shared a new single called "I Been", a perfect tune to add some light to your life. It’s that vibrant blissful music that brings people together and makes the world move, with a track that gives you everything from a mazing sound in the production, vocals that will melt you, and the writing narrates it all perfectly to make us keep coming back for more.

The single "I Been" is the number 5 on his solid album called "Allow Me to introduce Myself". Jay B brings an anthem that delivers to the fullest on the new song “I Been”. The music brings a hip hop sound, to bring a good feel to the music that works to the fullest.
